title: Developer refinances Isle of Wight scheme in three weeks
summary:
A developer has secured a £2.39 million land bridge facility for a 72-home residential scheme on the Isle of Wight, completing the refinance in three weeks through Fiduciam. The borrower had one month remaining on an already-extended bridging facility when the original lender could not extend further.

title: Aspen completes £1.9m bridge-to-let in Cheshire
summary:
Specialist lender Aspen Bridging has completed a £1.935 million bridge-to-let facility on a residential property in Alderley Edge, Cheshire, with the transaction finalised in 14 days. The financing supports the refinancing of a five-bedroom detached property spanning 6,500 square feet.

title: Lender provides £15.6m for 92 supported living units
summary:
United Trust Bank has provided £15.6 million in development finance to convert two redundant buildings in south-west London into 92 supported living units for vulnerable adults. The two schemes have a combined gross development value of £26.5 million.

The post Lender provides £15.6m for 92 supported living units appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Property software firm Alto launches AI tools for agents
summary:
Property technology company Alto has released a suite of artificial intelligence features designed to automate routine tasks for estate and letting agents, following an 18-month development period. The software provider has introduced six AI-powered functions to handle processes including property appraisals, listing creation, and sales progression tracking.

title: Devon estate agency acquired in 408-property deal
summary:
A four-branch estate agency in Devon has been acquired by franchisee Sara Watkins-Schmidt, expanding her managed property portfolio from 33 to 408 properties. The acquisition of Complete Estate Agency adds 375 managed properties and 23 employees to Watkins-Schmidt's operation.

title: UK property agents face new harassment liability from October
summary:
Estate and letting agents across the UK will face expanded legal obligations regarding workplace harassment from October 2026, following the Employment Rights Act 2025 receiving Royal Assent in December 2025. The legislation introduces three key changes affecting property professionals, with confirmed implementation dates now published by the government.

The post UK property agents face new harassment liability from October appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Landlord costs rise 56% as rental income grows 26%
summary:
Landlord operating costs have increased more than twice as fast as rental income over the past five years, according to analysis of official tax data. Research based on HMRC statistics found expenses rose 56% whilst rental income grew 26%, with the proportion of income consumed by costs climbing from 47.8% to 58.9%.

title: New index ranks UK auction houses on performance metrics
summary:
A property data firm has launched a comparative index ranking Britain's leading auction houses based on performance metrics including success rates, geographic coverage and transparency. Savills topped the rankings with a score of 100 out of 100, followed by Allsop at 94 and SDL Property Auctions at 88.

title: UK mortgage approvals fall to 56,100 in July
summary:
UK mortgage approvals for house purchases declined to 56,100 in July, down from 58,200 in June, according to Bank of England data. The 3.7% monthly decrease represents a 15% year-on-year fall and sits 7.3% below the five-year average.

title: UK house prices rise 0.2% in August, ending decline
summary:
UK house prices increased 0.2% month-on-month in August to reach an average of £275,465, according to Nationwide, marking the first monthly rise since April. The rise follows a three-month decline as the market awaits the Bank of England's interest rate decision on 17 September.
